title: BIR Form No. 2200-P — Excise Tax Return for Petroleum Products

choice_rows.label: Item 12 — Availing of tax relief under a Special Law or International Tax Treaty?

validation.how: Messages render as text in a 'Needs review' section after Part III (first 20 only); a field only turns its label red, and Queue for submission is disabled with no message beside it.

lists.label: Part V — Schedule 1: Removals and Excise Tax Due

findings.field: Part V — Schedule 1: Removals and Excise Tax Due
findings.now: Schedule 1 always shows 27 rows (25 product rows plus two 'Others') with no Add control, so a filer with more 'Others' products cannot enter them.
findings.why: The official page has an Add button (sched1AddBtn, BIR-Form2200Pv2020.hta:4134, calling addRowSched1 at line 5494) that appends rows, but the view loops only over FORM_2200P_SCHEDULE_ROWS.

options.name: Add row button
options.detail: Append 'Others' rows like the official Add, with a stated maximum, and Delete only on added rows.

options.name: Block with a clear message
options.detail: Refuse to queue when more than two 'Others' products are needed and name the limit.

findings.now: The month buttons stay active after the draft opens from a library tile, so picking another month and saving files the draft under that month, and the original tile then opens a new blank draft.
findings.why: The dashboard period selects the saved draft (queueable_forms.rs:43-47), but the save key is the draft's own month (db/queueable.rs:141-152 via filing_period() at form_2200p.rs:1032-1034), so the two keys can split.

options.name: Lock month after first save
options.detail: Keep Item 1 — Month read-only once a draft exists so the tile period stays the key.

options.name: Open by stored key
options.detail: Open the draft by its stored Item 1 month and show the tile period only as a label.

findings.now: Queue for submission greys out whenever any error exists, and the explanation sits only under Needs review after Part III, far below the toolbar.
findings.why: The button is disabled while validation_errors or parse_errors is non-empty, so the 'Fix the items listed under Needs review before submitting.' message in mark_submitted cannot be reached from the button.

options.name: Inline message per field
options.detail: Show each official alert text under the field that failed, not only in the panel.

options.name: Toolbar summary
options.detail: Show the first error text beside Queue for submission.

options.name: Keep enabled and scroll
options.detail: Let a click scroll to Needs review and focus the first failing field.

findings.now: Item 1 Month is a row of twelve small buttons rather than a dropdown.
findings.why: The official page uses a month select (BIR-Form2200Pv2020.hta:453), and twelve options is past the four-option limit for a button row.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A twelve-item select like the official dropdown and the place pickers already on this page.

options.name: Segmented control
options.detail: Keep buttons only where all twelve fit one row.

findings.now: The RDO shows as bold static text from the profile with no control on this page, so a missing or invalid value blocks queueing and the page offers no way to fix it.
findings.why: The official page shows an RDO dropdown in div#rdoContainer (BIR-Form2200Pv2020.hta:548-550) that the filer can change, while the port renders it as static text.

options.name: Dropdown
options.detail: Offer the official RDO list as a searchable select bound to rdo_code.

options.name: Read-only with profile link
options.detail: Keep it fixed but link to the profile setting that owns the RDO.

findings.now: Print preview leaves the contact number and email on the sheet blank, and the Region, Province and City codes for Items 10 and 11 are not printed.
findings.why: writer-cells.json lists the shared Item 8/9 comb and both Item 10/11 place combs under left_out (p1c34, p1c39, p1c44), so no join writes them.

options.name: Write both values into the comb
options.detail: Print contact and email as one text run in the shared comb, labelled so the filer can tell them apart.

options.name: Print a place and contact note
options.detail: Add a continuation line that lists the codes and the contact and email values.

options.name: Warn before preview
options.detail: Name the items the frozen sheet cannot show until the combs are mapped.

findings.now: Not a page control: commit 2f0b6506 (titled for 2200A and 2200P) edits the 2200A page, and commit 750fef8d edits the shared layout generator, both outside this form's own files.
findings.why: form_2200a_view.rs:1380-1381 gains a 2200A print preview (34 lines changed in a different form's page), and official.js:202 adds a guard to the shared cell-fill loop in prepare() (official.js:120), which every form's layout generation runs through.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Move the 2200A print preview into its own 2200A change so the 2200P commit touches only 2200P files.

options.name: Scope the generator change
options.detail: Gate the official.js cell-fill change on the 2200M, 2200C and 2200P layout ids so other forms' output cannot change.

findings.now: Typing 32 to 99 into Item 1 Day shows 'Day field on Page 1 Item 1 is required.' instead of the official 'Please provide a valid date. (MM/DD/YYYY format) in Page 1 Item 1.'
findings.why: sync_from_inputs maps any day outside 0-31 to 0, and validate() then reports a blank Day rather than the official date alert (BIR-Form2200Pv2020.hta:5836).

options.name: Pass the typed number through
options.detail: Let validate() raise the valid-date alert that the official validateDate raises.

options.name: Two-digit box
options.detail: Cap the Day box at two digits, as the official maxlength does.

findings.now: Typing a future year shows 'Page 1 Item 1 Date cannot be a future date ' and keeps the value, where the official page clears the year and shows 'Year shall not be greater than the present year'.
findings.why: The official Year box runs checkYear() on blur (BIR-Form2200Pv2020.hta:473 and 6107-6116), but the port's date_error() returns only the validateDate future-date text (form_2200p.rs:728), so the year alert never appears.

options.name: Mirror checkYear
options.detail: Clear the Year box and show 'Year shall not be greater than the present year' when the year is above the current year.

options.name: Keep the date alert
options.detail: Keep the future-date text, since the date check is what fails, but note that it is the validateDate message.
